children: Infinite Node Foundation (NODE), the holder of the CryptoPunks intellectual property, said it accepted a donation of Punk Strategy and took over its management; its first move was to reduce the token’s trading fee from 10% to 5%. According to Foresight News, Punk Strategy was launched in September 2025 by TokenWorks, the team behind an on-chain financialization experiment. The protocol uses trading activity for its token to buy CryptoPunks and list them for resale, then uses the proceeds to buy back and burn tokens. It was the first token launched in TokenWorks’ Strategy series. NODE said Punk Strategy was developed by an independent team and had no prior affiliation with NODE or the original CryptoPunks creators. Foresight News previously reported that Yuga Labs sold the CryptoPunks intellectual property to Infinite Node Foundation in May 2025.

title: Infinite Node Foundation Accepts Punk Strategy Donation, Cuts Token Trading Fee to 5%
